note: Colorbox Media Video provides one field formatter, colorbox_media_remote_video (field types link/string/string_long), for the core Remote Video oEmbed field; it opens the clip in a Colorbox modal. No settings page and no configure route (configure=null). All config lives on a view display: core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.type = colorbox_media_remote_video with settings display (thumbnail|text|media_title), link_text, image_style, colorbox_gallery (post|page|field_post|field_page|custom|none), colorbox_gallery_custom, colorbox_caption (auto|title|alt|entity_title|custom|none), colorbox_caption_custom, plus inherited oEmbed max_width/max_height (schema field.formatter.settings.colorbox_media_remote_video). Medium/hard cases are grounded on a namespaced string field field_cmv_* on the Article node type whose default view display uses this formatter, verified against live core.entity_view_display config (kept off the shared media.remote_video display to avoid clobbering other agents).

evals.prompt: In the colorbox_media_video module, what is the machine id of the field formatter it provides, and on which core Media type / field is it meant to be used to open videos in a Colorbox modal?
evals.expected_output: The formatter id is colorbox_media_remote_video. You select it on the Remote Video media type's Video URL field (field_media_oembed_video, an oEmbed field) via Manage display, and it launches the remote video in a Colorbox modal.

evals.prompt: The Colorbox Media Remote Video formatter can launch the modal from different things. What are the 'display' launcher options, and which formatter setting controls grouping videos into a Colorbox gallery?
evals.expected_output: The 'display' setting can be thumbnail, text, or media_title. Gallery grouping is controlled by the colorbox_gallery setting (post, page, field_post, field_page, custom, or none).

evals.prompt: Using colorbox_media_video, how do I control the caption shown on the video lightbox, and what extra module do I need for a custom token-based caption or gallery id?
evals.expected_output: The colorbox_caption setting chooses the caption source (auto, title, alt, entity_title, custom, none); custom uses colorbox_caption_custom. Custom captions and custom gallery ids (colorbox_gallery=custom) use token replacement, which needs the token module installed.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field field_cmv_video whose default display uses the Colorbox Media Remote Video formatter in text-launcher mode. Inspect the live view-display configuration and tell me the exact link text it launches the modal with.
evals.expected_output: The link text is 'Watch the clip': in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_cmv_video component has type colorbox_media_remote_video with settings.display = text and settings.link_text = 'Watch the clip'.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a field field_cmv_gallery displayed with the Colorbox Media Remote Video formatter. Inspect the live view-display config and state which Colorbox gallery grouping strategy (colorbox_gallery value) it is configured with.
evals.expected_output: colorbox_gallery is 'page' (Per page gallery): in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_cmv_gallery component's settings.colorbox_gallery = page.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field field_cmv_task that currently displays with the plain string formatter on its default view display. Using the colorbox_media_video module, change the default view display so this field uses the Colorbox Media Remote Video formatter. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_cmv_task component has type = colorbox_media_remote_video.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a field field_cmv_grp already using the Colorbox Media Remote Video formatter on its default view display, currently with per-post gallery grouping. Reconfigure that formatter so all such videos on a page are grouped into a single per-page Colorbox gallery, and apply the change live.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_cmv_grp component keeps type colorbox_media_remote_video and its settings.colorbox_gallery is changed from 'post' to 'page'.
